internalProducts: "an array of actual internal product names; use an empty array for no items, never a placeholder item such as unknown." Since no internal product names are explicitly given, I'll use an empty array.

execution: "one scalar, executed or not-executed." Since I'm not calling any tool (no echo command requested), execution="not-executed".
